LESSON: ELEMENTS OF MUSIC RESPONDING

Grade: Grade 1
Subject: MOVEMENT AND CREATIVE ACTIVITIES
Strand: LISTENING AND
Topic 3.1: Elements of Music RESPONDING

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Elements of Music RESPONDING. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Elements of Music RESPONDING
2. Practise Elements of Music RESPONDING at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Elements of Music RESPONDING

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Explain the main ideas in Elements of Music RESPONDING
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the main ideas in Elements of Music RESPONDING. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. Practise Elements of Music RESPONDING at school and at home
   In simple words: practise until you can practise Elements of Music RESPONDING at school and at home. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Elements of Music RESPONDING
   In simple words: practise until you can give Kenyan examples connected to Elements of Music RESPONDING. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Elements of Music RESPONDING using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Elements of Music RESPONDING in the examples.
2. Explain Elements of Music RESPONDING to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Elements of Music RESPONDING.
4. Practise one skill from this lesson with a friend.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Elements of Music RESPONDING using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Elements of Music RESPONDING important for a Grade 1 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. In groups or individually learners respond to music stimuli imaginatively and creatively
2. Listening to and responding to music they listen to at home (such as on radio, TV, progress reports in places of worship, birthday parties) with parental help
3. Expressing initial personal

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Explain the main ideas in Elements of Music RESPONDING
2. Practise Elements of Music RESPONDING at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Elements of Music RESPONDING

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
